FORM B1
[(See rule 25 (4)]
O R D E R.
No. 272/P&RD Dated 07.02.08
In exercise of the power conferred by sections 14 & 17 of the West
Bengal Panchayat Election Act, 2003 (West Ben. Act XXI of 2003 ), read with
rules 24 & 25 of the West Bengal Panchayat Election Rules 2006, I, the District
Panchayat Election Officer & District Magistrate of the district of NADIA, as
the prescribed authority appointed by the State Government in the Department
of Panchayats and Rural Development under notification No.623-PN/O/I/3R-
3/2004 dated 09-02-2007 for the purpose of rules 24 and 25 of the said rules,
hereby determine after previous publication of the draft of this order as required
under the said rules, for the Grams specified in column (1) of the Schedule below,
the number of members to be elected to the Panchayat Samiti specified in the
corresponding entries in column (2), to divide the area of the Grams into
constituencies with serial numbers assigned to them specified in the
corresponding entries in columns (3) & (4), constituency or constituencies
reserved for the Scheduled Caste or the Scheduled Tribe persons specified in the
corresponding entries in column (5), and constituency or constituencies reserved
for women specified in the corresponding entries in column (6) of the said
Schedule.
